name: Ontherox
look: a hefty golem of crystal-clear ice: a translucent cube body with a frosty core, a cube head and ice-ball fists and feet
entry: Unlike normal ice, Ontherox is forged under immense pressure, making it so dense that it clinks like solid stone and takes weeks to thaw.
how: Wild: rare in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Slow Melt halves super-effective Fire damage, and a Fire hit slicks the ground, lowering its foes' Speed.
